ai_summary: Aurionpro Solutions Limited reported the proceedings of its 29th Annual General Meeting, where shareholders considered adopting FY2026 financial statements and approving dividends. Materially, the meeting included special resolutions seeking approval to create mortgages/charges on company assets and enhance overall borrowing limits. While voting results are pending, these proposals suggest a potential intent for increased leverage and asset-backed financing, warranting investor attention on the company's future capital structure.
